headline: Nigerian Fintech Moniepoint Offers Voluntary Exits in Engineering Overhaul
summary: African fintech unicorn Moniepoint is offering voluntary departure packages to staff in its engineering and product departments as part of a restructuring plan.
why: Moniepoint is a leading business banking and payments platform in West Africa; workforce adjustments highlight ongoing efficiency and cost management in the African fintech sector.

impacts.name: Moniepoint
impacts.why: Voluntary departures streamline technical teams but involve short-term severance expenses.
